title: LaLumiere Massage Boutique
specs: Preferred provider through Moda and Regence Blue Cross Blue Shield insurance
Prenatal massage only offered after 13 weeks of pregnancy
Arrive 15 minutes early for new clients to fill out intake form
Undress to level of comfort; clients are draped with linens
Do not attend if sick or impaired; wait 72 hours after vaccine or illness before massage
Side by side massage available for couples in private suite

explain.meaning: An off-road vehicle with side-by-side seats and a steering wheel.
Suction cups placed on the skin to loosen tight muscles.
Massage using warmed smooth stones on the muscles.
A facial that gently buffs away dead skin.

includes: Use of linens for draping during massage
Complimentary beverage service with hot tea or spring water for side by side massage
blurb: Guests receive professional massage therapy including relaxation, therapeutic, hot stone, cupping, prenatal, migraine relief, side by side, and accident or injury therapy. Spa services include facials such as Go & Glow, Signature, Indulge, Microderm, and Blue Radiance Chemical Peel. Enhancements like aromatherapy, hot stones, scalp rejuvenation, and magnesium treatments can be added to massages.
extraNote: 24 hour cancellation policy; full price charged for same day cancel or no show · Three strike rule for same day cancel or no show; may be refused service · Gift certificates redeemable by dollar amount, not service · Main entrance and parking in alleyway between Court Street and State Street, free parking in reserved spots.
